video.title: App Protocol, WindowGroup & ScenePhase | Day 170
video.description:
Learn to explain how a SwiftUI app starts and reacts to its state: App Protocol, WindowGroup & ScenePhase, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
App Protocol - A protocol for the main type of a SwiftUI app, marked with @main, that describes its scenes.
WindowGroup - A scene that shows your root view in a window, and can open more windows on iPad and Mac.
ScenePhase - An environment value that tells you if the scene is active, inactive or in the background.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain App Protocol, WindowGroup & ScenePhase in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
앱 프로토콜, 윈도우그룹, 씬페이즈 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

App Protocol - A protocol for the main type of a SwiftUI app, marked with @main, that describes its scenes.
한국어: 앱 프로토콜: @main이 붙은 SwiftUI 앱의 메인 타입을 위한 프로토콜로, 앱의 씬을 설명해요

WindowGroup - A scene that shows your root view in a window, and can open more windows on iPad and Mac.
한국어: 윈도우그룹: 루트 뷰를 창에 보여 주고, iPad와 Mac에서는 창을 더 열 수 있는 씬

ScenePhase - An environment value that tells you if the scene is active, inactive or in the background.
한국어: 씬페이즈: 씬이 활성, 비활성, 백그라운드 중 어떤 상태인지 알려 주는 환경 값

landscape.hook: Can you explain App Protocol, WindowGroup and ScenePhase in English?

dialogue.title: Where does the app start?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I started a new SwiftUI project, and I cannot find the old start file.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The entry point is a type with the App Protocol, and it is marked with `@main`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The App Protocol asks for one thing, a `body` that returns scenes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What is the scene in my code?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A WindowGroup. It shows your root view in a window.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can it open more than one window?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: On iPad and Mac, yes. Each window from the WindowGroup has its own state.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now I want to save data when the app goes to the background.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Read ScenePhase from the environment. It tells you if the scene is active, inactive or in the background.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And where do I react to it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Watch the ScenePhase with a change handler, and save when the app is in the background.
The App Protocol is where your app starts.
